import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

class BudgetEnforcer:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("BudgetEnforcer")
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect("budget.db")
        self.cursor = self.conn.cursor()

            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (

                name TEXT NOT NULL,

            )
        """)

        self.notebook.add(self.expenses_frame, text="Expenses")
        self.notebook.add(self.income_frame, text="Income")
        self.notebook.add(self.settings_frame, text="Settings")

        # Expenses frame
        self.expenses_label = tk.Label(self.expenses_frame, text="Expenses")
        self.expenses_label.pack()

        self.expenses_listbox = tk.Listbox(self.expenses_frame)
        self.expenses_listbox.pack()

        self.add_expense_button = tk.Button(self.expenses_frame, text="Add Expense")
        self.add_expense_button.pack()

        # Income frame
        self.income_label = tk.Label(self.income_frame, text="Income")
        self.income_label.pack()

        self.income_listbox = tk.Listbox(self.income_frame)
        self.income_listbox.pack()

        self.add_income_button = tk.Button(self.income_frame, text="Add Income")
        self.add_income_button.pack()

        # Settings frame
        self.settings_label = tk.Label(self.settings_frame, text="Settings")
        self.settings_label.pack()

        self.settings_button = tk.Button(self.settings_frame, text="Settings")
        self.settings_button.pack()

    def run(self):
        self.root.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    budget_enforcer = BudgetEnforcer(root)
    budget_enforcer.run()
```
